# Stardew Valley Companion

> A free, browser-based progress tracker for Stardew Valley.
> Data is stored in your browser. No account or login is required. Cloud sync is optional.

## What it tracks

- **Collections**: fish, artifacts, minerals, cooking, crafting, crops, forageables, animal products, artisan goods, monster loot, rarecrows and special items
- **Farm**: farmer profile, skills, mastery, tools, animals, buildings and Ginger Island
- **Villagers, Town and Calendar**: hearts and events, shops and hours, birthdays and festivals by season
- **Progress**: Mines and Skull Cavern, quests and special orders, the Community Center or Joja route, Grandpa's evaluation and the perfection score
- **Gear and items needed**: weapons, footwear, rings, hats, trinkets, and what is still needed across every list
- **Playthroughs**: several farms, kept apart, from a save file or built by hand

## Pages

- `/overview`: progress across every area
- `/farm`, `/villagers`, `/town`, `/calendar`
- `/collections`, `/gear`, `/items-needed`
- `/mines`, `/quests`, `/community-center`, `/grandpa`, `/perfection`
- `/playthroughs`: manage the saved playthroughs
- `/settings`: optional cloud sync, preferences, backup and data

## Technical notes

- Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
- Save file import: reads Stardew Valley save files in the browser
- No backend and no analytics code in the app. Playthrough data lives in browser localStorage
- Data can be exported as a JSON file for backup and imported again at any time
- Cloud sync, when turned on, keeps one file in your own Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or GitHub
- Open source, no ads
